experiment: OnceNet training by matching factorial confirmation
purpose: Separate the contribution of existing mathematical pretraining from negative-aware matching on fresh labeled real spectrograms.
weights: Existing v46 spectrogram checkpoints paired with each seed's exact saved v45 random initialization. All seeds retained; no winner selection.
inputs: Same authentic 0.5,1,2,4 second renders, full and low-frequency views, fixed deployed preprocessing, identical spatial-statistic descriptor in all four conditions.
runtime_intent: Strict FP32 CUDA with TF32 and mixed precision disabled; all historical features recomputed identically. Compare to CPU on already-used fixtures before freezing.
fit_and_calibration: Identical historical FIT and CAL identities per target; ELDA uses FIT, cosine ignores FIT by design. Threshold calibrated separately for each condition on the same CAL, with conservative ties.
primary_endpoint: Macro standardized partial AUROC at max false-positive rate 0.001
co_primary_contrasts: trained minus random averaged over matchers
ELDA minus cosine averaged over training conditions
co_primary_intervals: Two-sided97.5percent paired detector-hour cluster bootstrap intervals,2000 draws,seed51106; conditional on the three fixed seeds and five reference episodes.
fresh_data_intent: Human-validated GravitySpy events with authentic four-window sources, excluding all identifiable previously consumed events and detector-hour groups. Metadata-label-based sampling is declared; prior195event confirmation is consumed and excluded.
sample_size_intent: Up to100 events per target plus3000 outside-target negatives, subject to available untouched human-labeled events. Final identities and sizes frozen before fresh image acquisition or model scoring.
freeze_order: implementation checks on synthetic arrays and used fixtures
fresh image acquisition with label-independent integrity exclusions
claims_excluded: reusing the old confirmation as fresh data
limitations: Negative-aware matching contrast includes the benefit of using background FIT data, not just a different algebraic formula.
Five reference episodes and three seeds do not multiply the number of independent query events.
Low-alarm tail precision depends on actual available independent negatives; no advance promise of significance.
